data.name: Anjaneyulu
data.gender_notes: Anjaneyulu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjaneyulu is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Hanuman's younger brother'. Hanuman is a popular deity in Hindu mythology, known for his strength, loyalty, and devotion to Lord Rama. Anjaneyulu is revered as an embodiment of these qualities and is often considered a symbol of bravery, devotion, and wisdom. The name Anjaneyulu carries the meaning “Hanuman's younger brother” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjaneyulu usually hope their child will grow to embody hanuman's younger brother and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Anjaneyulu is a revered name in Hindu culture, associated with the legendary figure of Lord Hanuman's younger brother. Hanuman is renowned for his unwavering loyalty and devotion to Lord Rama and Sita, and his feats of strength and courage have been recounted in various Hindu Epics and Folktales for centuries. Anjaneyulu is a reminder of these qualities and is often invoked for strength, courage, and wisdom in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: Anjaneyulu is a symbol of devotion, loyalty, and wisdom in Hindu spirituality. He represents the qualities of a true devotee, someone who is selfless, unwavering in their faith, and willing to go to great lengths in service of their deity. The name Anjaneyulu serves as a reminder of these spiritual ideals and can inspire one to strive for greater devotion and spiritual growth in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anjaneyulu, meaning 'Son of Anjani', signifies purity, devotion, and strength. Anjaneya, the monkey god, embodies these qualities in his unwavering loyalty to Lord Rama. Anjaneyulu's name is a constant reminder of the power of devotion and the strength it can provide in challenging times.
